description: Summary figure: JIP4 pLDDT/domain map, PAE, Foldseek fold assignment to the USP superfamily, ATP-pocket occlusion test, and feature comparison with YOR019W and yeast SR-like proteins
code:
import os, json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
OUT=os.getcwd()
plddt=np.load(os.path.join(OUT,"plddt_Q03361.npy")); P=np.load(os.path.join(OUT,"pae_Q03361.npy"))
J="".join(open(os.path.join(OUT,"Q03361.fasta")).read().split("\n")[1:]); L=len(J)
print("pLDDT in RS repeat 343-352: mean %.1f"%plddt[342:352].mean(),
      " | insert 311-381 mean %.1f"%plddt[310:381].mean(),
      " | USP core 270-310 %.1f"%plddt[269:310].mean(), " 382-487 %.1f"%plddt[381:487].mean())
print("pLDDT in RS-rich 671-726: mean %.1f"%plddt[670:726].mean())

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,11))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1.05,1.15,1.0],hspace=0.45,wspace=0.28)

# A: pLDDT track
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
x=np.arange(1,L+1)
ax.fill_between(x,0,plddt,color='#9aa7b8',lw=0)
ax.plot(x,plddt,color='#2f3b4c',lw=0.7)
ax.axhline(70,color='#c0392b',ls='--',lw=1)
for s,e,c,lab in [(184,490,'#2e86de','Pfam PF29926 (JIP4 N-term)'),(581,664,'#8e44ad','Pfam PF29925 (helical)')]:
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((s,103),e-s,7,color=c,clip_on=False))
    ax.text((s+e)/2,112,lab,ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=8,color=c)
for s,e in [(183,222),(270,310),(382,487),(579,632)]:
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((s,95),e-s,6,color='#27ae60',clip_on=False))
ax.text(10,96,'green = ordered segments called here (pLDDT$_{smooth}\\geq$70)',fontsize=8,color='#27ae60')
ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((343,0),10,100,color='#e67e22',alpha=.35,lw=0))
ax.text(348,30,'(RS)$_5$\n343-352',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#b9560f')
ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((671,0),56,100,color='#e67e22',alpha=.20,lw=0))
ax.text(699,30,'R/S-rich\n671-726',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#b9560f')
for p in [48,51,360,510,552,577,775]:
    ax.plot(p,plddt[p-1],'v',color='#c0392b',ms=6); ax.text(p,plddt[p-1]+4,f'S{p}',ha='center',fontsize=7,color='#c0392b')
ax.set_xlim(0,L+1); ax.set_ylim(0,120); ax.set_yticks([0,25,50,70,90,100])
ax.set_xlabel('JIP4 / Q03361 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('AlphaFold pLDDT')
ax.set_title('A  Only 27.5% of JIP4 is confidently ordered, and the ordered part is one module plus one helical hairpin',fontsize=10,loc='left')

# B: PAE
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
im=ax.imshow(P,cmap='Greens_r',vmin=0,vmax=31,extent=[1,L,L,1])
for s,e in [(183,222),(270,310),(382,487),(579,632)]:
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((s,s),e-s,e-s,fill=False,ec='#c0392b',lw=1))
ax.set_title('B  PAE: segments 183-487 form one domain;\n579-632 is structurally independent',fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.set_xlabel('residue'); ax.set_ylabel('residue')
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax,label='predicted aligned error ($\\AA$)',fraction=0.046)

# C: Foldseek top hits
import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"foldseek_JIP4_183_487_hits.csv"))
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
sel=[("YOR019W (yeast WGD paralog)",'afdb-swissprot','Q99248'),("YGR237C (yeast)",'afdb-swissprot','P50089'),
     ("UspA family prot. C25B2.10 (S. pombe)",'afdb-swissprot','O74782'),("MJ0577 USP, ATP-bound",'afdb-swissprot','Q57997'),
     ("USP PHOS32 (A. thaliana)",'afdb-swissprot','Q8VYN9'),("1MJH MJ0577 (PDB)",'pdb100','1mjh-assembly1.cif.gz_A'),
     ("3HGM TeaD USP (PDB)",'pdb100','3hgm-assembly1.cif.gz_B'),("3S3T UspA L. plantarum (PDB)",'pdb100','3s3t'),
     ("3TNJ USP + AMP (PDB)",'pdb100','3tnj'),("4R2L UspF Salmonella (PDB)",'pdb100','4r2l')]
labs=[];vals=[];cols=[]
for lab,db,key in sel:
    sub=df[(df.db==db)&(df.target.str.contains(key,regex=False))]
    if len(sub): labs.append(lab); vals.append(-np.log10(sub['eval'].min())); cols.append('#2e86de' if db=='pdb100' else '#16a085')
o=np.argsort(vals)
ax.barh([labs[i] for i in o],[vals[i] for i in o],color=[cols[i] for i in o])
ax.axvline(-np.log10(0.001),color='#c0392b',ls='--',lw=1); ax.text(-np.log10(0.001),-0.8,'E=1e-3',color='#c0392b',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('Foldseek $-\\log_{10}$(E-value), query = JIP4 183-487')
ax.set_title('C  Structure search assigns the fold:\nuniversal stress protein (USP) / adenine nucleotide\nalpha hydrolase-like',fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# D: ATP pocket test
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
t=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"jip4_atp_pocket_test.json")))
ax.bar(['MJ0577\n(own ATP)','JIP4 USP domain\n(ATP transplanted)'],[t['mj0577_clash_2.5A'],t['jip4_clash_2.5A']],color=['#27ae60','#c0392b'])
ax.set_ylabel('heavy atoms within 2.5 $\\AA$ of ATP')
ax.set_title(f"D  The nucleotide site is occluded in JIP4\n(core RMSD {t['core_rmsd']:.2f} $\\AA$ over {t['n_core']} C$\\alpha$)",fontsize=10,loc='left')
for i,v in enumerate([t['mj0577_clash_2.5A'],t['jip4_clash_2.5A']]): ax.text(i,v+0.2,str(v),ha='center')
ax.text(0.5,8,"JIP4 clashing residues:\nHis277, Ile278, Ser279,\nThr284, Asn307, Ser438",fontsize=8,ha='center')

# E: feature comparison
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1]); ax.axis('off')
tbl=[["feature","JIP4","YOR019W","Npl3/Gbp2/Hrb1"],
     ["USP fold (PF29926)","184-490","164-407","absent"],
     ["SSF52402 by sequence","not called","239-366","absent"],
     ["helical dom. PF29925","581-664","470-549","absent"],
     ["(RS)n repeat, n>=3","343-352 (RS)5","none","none"],
     ["R/S-rich LC window","318-371, 671-726","none","none"],
     ["RRM","absent","absent","present (2-3)"],
     ["RGG box","absent","absent","present"],
     ["bipartite NLS pattern","46-62","none","n/a"],
     ["UniProt phosphosites","7 (6 disordered)","see text","many"]]
tb=ax.table(cellText=tbl[1:],colLabels=tbl[0],loc='center',cellLoc='left')
tb.auto_set_font_size(False); tb.set_fontsize(8); tb.scale(1,1.45)
for j in range(4): tb[0,j].set_facecolor('#dfe6ec')
ax.set_title('E  Feature comparison with the WGD paralog and with yeast SR-like proteins',fontsize=10,loc='left')
plt.show()
